name: Editor Collab
description: Build levels together in real time with your friends - no setup, just share a room code.

display-name.name: Display Name
display-name.description: Name other people see. Leave empty to use your GD account name.

sync-interval.name: Sync Interval (seconds)
sync-interval.description: How often changes are sent and received. Lower is snappier, higher is lighter on big levels.

show-peers.name: Show Other Players
show-peers.description: Show a marker where each collaborator's camera is.

use-custom-server.name: Use My Own Server
use-custom-server.description: Host rooms on your own Editor Collab server instead of the global one. Friends join with the invite you copy (CODE@address).

server-url.name: My Server Address
server-url.description: Address of your own server, e.g. <cy>127.0.0.1:8484</c>.
